name: Hajimete no Otetsudai
original_name: はじめてのおてつだい
source:
Landlord asks main character to help about the cafe on the first floor of the building. It turns out to be a maid cafe where two cute twins are working already. It's confusing to be called "onii-chan", but promise needs to be fulfilled.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
房东请主角帮忙处理大楼一楼的咖啡馆。原来是一家女仆咖啡厅，里面已经有两个可爱的双胞胎在工作了。被称为“哥哥”虽然让人感到困惑，但承诺是需要兑现的。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
